Kevin Trudeau says there's one hack behind every success story he's ever studied: keep your eye on the dream, not on the problem.

Earl Nightingale put it simply - you become what you think about most of the time. Fight the problem and you only feed it more energy; it gets bigger, not smaller.

The moment you shift your focus back to the goal, the universe starts moving you toward it instead.

Which one are you actually staring at right now - the problem, or the goal?

#kevintrudeau #mindsetmatters #successhabits #moneymindset #wealthmindset #millionairemindset

The Federal Trade Commission sued Kevin Trudeau over a supplement he sold on TV, coral calcium, and tried to wipe him out financially and shut him down for good.

The settlement banned him from TV infomercials for products - but when he read the fine print, there was an exception for informational publications protected by the First Amendment. Books.

His own team told him it was impossible: nobody makes money selling a book on a TV infomercial. Not enough margin, they said.

He did it anyway, and that loophole became the biggest break of his career.

#kevintrudeau #businesslessons #moneymindset #successhabits #entrepreneurship #wealthmindset

Kevin Trudeau came up with the title in a hotel room after years of fighting the FTC: Natural Cures They Don't Want You To Know About.

He put it on a TV infomercial with no idea if anyone would buy a $20 book that way. Nobody had ever done it before.

It went on to become the number one bestselling book in America that year, holding the top spot on the New York Times list for 26 straight weeks, and sold almost 50 million copies in hardcover.

It would never have existed without the lawsuit that was supposed to destroy him.

#kevintrudeau #successstory #moneymindset #wealthmindset #millionairemindset #businesslessons

A few years later, the government hit Kevin Trudeau with a $37 million judgment. His team told him a receiver would take everything - the houses, even the toothbrushes - and he'd still owe money after.

Instead of fighting to keep what he had, he started something brand new: a foundation. A separate entity the government couldn't touch, because he never put a dollar of his own money into it.

That foundation became the Global Information Network, a club members say changed their marriages, their health and their income.

None of it would exist if the $37 million wipeout never happened.

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #businesslessons #successstory #moneymindset #millionairemindset

Kevin Trudeau was charged with contempt of court - not a crime, not a felony, just contempt - and still received the longest sentence in U.S. history for it: 10 years in federal prison.

He says he sat there shocked, but something in him knew it was a gift, even before he understood why. Viktor Frankl wrote the same thing from a concentration camp: they can control everything except your mind.

With no phone, no email, and nothing but time, Kevin spent years writing down everything he'd learned about success and manifesting.

That work became the Science of Personal Mastery course - it would not exist today without those 10 years.

#kevintrudeau #mindsetmatters #successstory #wealthmindset #millionairemindset #businesslessons

Kevin Trudeau was being transferred between federal prisons, stripped, searched, and handed paper pants and a paper T-shirt before being marched onto a tarmac in 20-degree weather.

Twelve armed marshals stood guard while every other prisoner shook and some nearly cried from the cold. Kevin used a technique called the breath of fire, the same one Tibetan monks use to sit on snow and melt it around them.

He stood there generating his own heat while the guards stared at him in amazement. One asked how. His answer: you can train your mind to do anything.

He didn't let the adversity control him. He took charge of it.
